methodology.cohortRule: Parsed professional matches in OpenDota, patch family 7.41, starting at the official 7.41e release timestamp.
methodology.roleRule: OpenDota notable-player fantasy_role: 1, 3 and 4 are core; 2 is support; unclassified rows are excluded.
methodology.timingRule: First non-recipe purchase per player and item after 0:00; quartiles are match minutes.
methodology.purchaseRateRule: Players with a first purchase divided by all classified player appearances in that role.
methodology.catalogRule: Items observed in the cohort plus their component tree; zero-cost and recipe records are excluded.
